name: Faya Palaeolandscape
description: Faya Palaeolandscape is a limestone hill and surrounding desert in Sharjah, about 50 km east of Sharjah city, between the Gulf and the Hajar Mountains. Stone tools and burials here span roughly 210,000 to 6,000 years of human life, through swings between arid and rainy climates. Tools about 125,000 years old resemble those from Sudan, hinting at an early route out of Africa.
